notes.title: House Builder second DLC release!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=4_UTvp6yUmI;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Hi Builders![/b]ːladyengineerːːthebuilderː 
Today sees the release of the long-awaited second DLC to House Builder! ːtheplanetː
We can't wait for you to try and play the new DLC - especially since the new houses 
are very unique as well as the surrounding area🏰 🏗️⚔️
Let's get to the point...🏇

[b]Here is the link to DLC with basic version of the game✅:[/b] https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42617/Medieval_Building_Creator
[b]We also prepared a [u]bundle with House Builder game[/u], for those who still haven't bought it:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42618/House_Builder__Pack_and_Punch

[h3]This brings us to the most interesting part - the new houses!:[/h3]
[h2][b]🌊Watermill house🌊[/b][/h2]
The world's first mills were built as early as 1 B.C.! The mechanism was equipped with a water wheel, the driving force of which was derived from the energy of the dammed water - this made it easy to grind cereals and produce flour and groats🥖. Mills had to be located close to rivers or streams🐄. At this level, you will be able to move into a Medieval mill, which will also be home to you - from now on you will be able to call yourself a miller!🔨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624373/02bccb317f3e56c622fbf792618f46cdb527e456.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624373/122dd3e81cb8aa1ca8e081d0092bd82cad715a4e.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]⚒️Blacksmith's house⚒️[/b][/h2]

Blacksmiths were a very important profession in the Middle Ages. Their main task was to make horseshoes so that the horses could work effectively and efficiently in the fields, and serve in transport and battle. The blacksmith also made barrels, nails, and various useful tools. It was a popular and respected profession - famous writers and chroniclers wrote about them. With the DLC, you will be able to feel like a medieval blacksmith - you will build your own house including a workshop!🐎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624373/55e58ee2f89e35d32e9fa3ea2e9f19749946ce10.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624373/fe2f5eb8dc1b51a2608e426a3d3a2044e8a94c0c.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]💨Windmill house💨[/b][/h2]

Windmills are structures with wings that, driven by the wind, are used to grind grain🍞. They are the oldest windmill engine invented by humans - they were invented in the ninth century in eastern Persia, while by the end of the twelfth century, they had spread to England and the Netherlands - and nowadays many people convert old windmills into houses. On the level, you will build a wooden windmill, which will also be a home for you!🏡

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624373/cbadf9509d9dc972ed6e62bf389f599db049438f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624373/30c74814fec5cb3b03d73fd004c0e1c6917c9d68.jpg[/img]

[b]So don't hesitate and grab it now: [/b]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2802330/House_Builder__The_Atomic_Age_DLC

[b]Some of you reported on the previous Atomic DLC that it was too expensive. Especially for you, we are lowering the price of the Medieval DLC (the price will be a dollar lower) - we believe that the current price will be optimal for You!💙[/b]

We have introduced an interesting novelty for you: from now on you can find out interesting facts about the Middle Ages on a map! Approach the information points from which sparks fly to find out interesting informationːtheplanetː

Developer's note:
if you are starting your story with House Builder, we recommend you start with the basic version of the game rather than the add-on - it will introduce you to the mechanics and make it easier to grasp the gameplayːiglooː

We warmly encourage you to participate in Steam discussions. We also encourage you to share your opinion about the game with other players🎮ːthebuilderː

To stay up to date, please also visit our Freemind Games studio's discord (where we also have dedicated channels for House Builder):
https://discord.gg/yj3NBVwT

Thank you for being there! ːladyengineerːːthebuilderː Without you, we would not have been able to develop the game this way and release this DLC. 
Thanks to your feedback and support, we can continue to create this game ❤️

House Builder Team
Have fun!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624373/b81a034bbe7c9a4353e758951f9023a1061512db.jpg[/img]
After purchasing the DLC, the first new house will appear in central Europe, roughly on the territory of today's Czech Republic🦉

P.S. Yesterday we announced a big and important game "[b]Purrrifiers[/b]". If you want to support us (Freemind or dev of the game) or have a chance to get into the beta test please wishlist now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2117430/Purrrifiers/

notes.title: House Builder - The Atomic Age DLC Release
notes.notes:
[h2][b]BETTER SAFE THAN SORRY![/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=pXumErrn-FI;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Hi Builders![/b]:ladyengineer::thebuilder: 
The long-awaited update is finally live - House Builder Atomic DLC with three new houses! :theplanet:
We are thrilled that you will be able to play this DLC - especially since the new houses 
are very unique👽👾🚀

Let's get to the point...

[b]Here is the link to DLC:[/b] https://store.steampowered.com/app/2802330/House_Builder__The_Atomic_Age_DLC

[b]We also prepared a [u]bundle with House Builder game[/u], for those who still haven't bought it:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/40609/Before_the_Fallout


[h3]What is all about DLC? Read below:[/h3]

[h2][b]☢️Shelter House☢️[/b][/h2]

These days, survivalists are preparing for hard times - forewarned is forearmed! The minimum ground thickness to protect against radiation is 90 centimeters. If the hideout is higher up, I would advise you to run away! On our level you will build a shelter at a safe depth in your garden - we reassure you that no nuke scares you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624373/86acf516cb84e068f7114d51d8a5dd6495be7e4f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624373/d18e6c661802f00b4787fa809bdc84dbd7529d33.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]💥Nuke House💥[/b][/h2]

We are located in Nevada. In 1951, a training ground of 3,500 square kilometers was designated here. More than a thousand explosions were carried out here - allowing you to test the power of nukes, which are still in the arsenal of many countries as weapons today. Your task will be to rebuild the house that was destroyed in the nuclear test!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624373/e89cf2d780e33fb83cb0b3178b88a4a63e0ced90.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624373/e8a2894069f9fae45a07d2ac01241fba7bb1b34f.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]👽UFO House👽[/b][/h2]

After an atomic bomb blast, an unidentified flying object falls on the American countryside. The craft encounters a strange constructor who decides to build a house out of the UFO without reporting it to anyone! Crazy idea, right? Get ready for an unearthly experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624373/136b69a7ab9479f2ae3d009454e972206e637b84.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37624373/8dceef3016c1b17a02980905bc6dc59403c81b4c.jpg[/img]

[b]So don't hesitate and grab it now: [/b]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2802330/House_Builder__The_Atomic_Age_DLC

We have also added:
- the possibility to disable voice messages after a completed stage ('impressive', 'good job', etc.). The 
options can be enabled in the game options once you have started the level;
- information at game start-up about the possible occurrence of an attack for people with epilepsy.

[b]You are warmly invited to complete our survey, which will help develop House Builder:
[url=https://forms.office.com/r/J0hRbe46xk]https://forms.office.com/r/J0hRbe46xk[/url]

Complete the survey and get a prize! :japantree:[/b]

We warmly encourage you to participate in Steam discussions. We also encourage you to share your opinion about the game with other players🎮:thebuilder:

To stay up to date, please also visit our Freemind Games studio's discord (where we also have dedicated channels for House Builder):
https://discord.gg/ncUfu7VH
